risks.risk: Actual sewing performance may differ from appearance (stitch quality, tension, timing).
risks.proof: Video of sewing a straight line and a zigzag on fabric, showing consistent stitches and correct tension.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully proven for correct sewing performance (worst case: needs adjustment/repair).

risks.risk: Motor/drive may run smoothly at idle but fail under load or have intermittent issues.
risks.proof: Video of motor running while sewing (under load) plus pedal speed control.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as motor performance unverified (worst case: weak/intermittent).

risks.risk: Accessories/manual may be missing or not original.
risks.proof: Photo of all accessories laid out and clear photo of the manual cover/pages showing the machine model.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as accessories/manual not guaranteed (worst case: incomplete set).

risks.risk: Exact brand/model not readable, affecting parts availability and comparable pricing.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the model/brand plate and any serial number label.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at generic electric sewing machine level (worst case: harder-to-source model).

risks.risk: Electrical completeness (cord, pedal, switch) not confirmed by photo.
risks.proof: Photo of power cord, pedal, and any switches/ports; video showing pedal controlling speed smoothly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as electrical function unverified (worst case: pedal/cord issues).

proof_requests: Please send a clear close-up photo of the brand/model plate and any serial number label.
Send a short video of sewing: straight stitch + zigzag on fabric (show stitch quality).
Send a short video of the motor running while sewing (under load) with pedal speed control.
Send photos of all accessories laid out and a clear photo of the manual (cover + a page showing the model).
Send clear photos of the power cord and pedal (and any switches/ports).
response.reason: The seller’s claim of testing is not verifiable remotely without new photos/videos. With only Photo 0 and unreadable model details, the key factors that determine price (true working sewing performance, exact model, and completeness) are still unproven.
